 The Sub-Licensee, having the necessary capacity is desirous to occupy the Unit and has approached the Licensee for assignment/sub-license of the Licence in his favour. 
 
 The Licensee, based on the representations of the Sub-Licensee, has agreed to assign/sub-license the l icence to occupy the Unit to the Sub-Licensee (“ Sub-License ”) subject to the terms and condition of the License a long with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

 INTERPRETATION 
 
 The above preamble/recitals shall be deemed to constitute an integral part of this Agreement which shall be construed accordingly. 
 
 Words importing the singular also include the plural and the masculine includes the feminine and vice versa, unless the context otherwise requires. 
 
 Headings in this Agreement are included for reference only and shall not constitute a part of this Agreement for any other purpose. 
 
 The language for this Agreement and all communication hereunder shall be English. 
 
 
 SUB-LICENSE 
 
 The Licensee hereby grants to the Sub-Licensee , the Sub-Licence, for the time period specified herein, to only occupy the Unit . 
 
 The rights under the Sub-Licence hereby granted to the Sub-Licensee shall be non-transferable and non- assignable. 
 
 The Sub-Licensee acknowledges that he/she only has the sublicense to occupy the Unit and this Sub - license does not create any form of tenancy. 
 
 All rights, titles and interests in respect of the Sub-Licence shall remain with the Licensee and nothing in this Agreement shall be construed so to permanently transfer any such rights, titles and interest.

 4.2 The Sublicense Fee shall be paid monthly in advance of each month but no later than the 10th day of the first month for which the fee is due. 
 
 4. 3 The Sub-Licensee shall also submit a security deposit of PKR [•] [•] [Insert amount in numerical and words] (“ Security Deposit ”) against the Sub - license granted herein. The amount of Security Deposit shall act as a security for any damage caused to the Unit, default on payments of Sub - license Fee and Service Charges by the Sub-Licensee. 
 
 4. 4 The Sub-Licensee shall be under an obligation to pay the monthly service charges (“ Service Charges ”) as and when due to the Licensor , as proportionate contribution towards the management, administration, maintenance and control of the Premises, without limitation the Unit, common areas, common facilities and parking space. The amount of Service Charges shall be determined and prescribed from time to time by the management company at its discretion.

 OBLIGATIONS AND REPRESENTATIONS OF THE LICENSEE 
 
 The Licensee hereby represents and warrants that it has the necessary title and interest in respect of the Licence and the right to sub-license the same subject to the terms and conditions contained in therein . 
 
 The Licensee hereby undertakes to inform the Sub-Licensee by notice in writing of any change in the terms of the License which shall affect the Sublicense granted herein. For avoidance of doubt any change in the terms of the License shall be construed as a change in terms of the Sublicense granted herein. 
 
 
 6. OBLIGATIONS OF THE SUB-LICENSEE 
 
 The Sub-Licensee hereby undertakes to: 
 
 pay to the Licensee the Sublicense Fee in the manner as prescribed under this Agreement; 
 
 to pay the monthly S ervice C harges to the Licensor in the bank account prescribed by the Licensor in the monthly invoice . 
 
 comply with all building rules (“ Building Rules ”), more specifically described in Annexure A of this Agreement ; 
 
 use the Unit for its permitted use only as prescribed under the Building Rules; 
 
 accept and comply with any changes in the terms of the Sublicense subject to Clause 5.2 above. 
 
 allow the Lisensee or the building management representative to visit and the right to enter the Unit for inspection at any time with prior notice of 24 (twenty-four) hours to the Sub-Licensee, and the Licensee or the building management representative shall never be denied of this right. 
 
 In the event of an emergency, the prior notice of 24 (twenty-hours) in Clause (vi) above shall not be applicable and the Licensee or the building management representative or emergency responders shall be allowed to enter the Unit without any delay by the Sub-Licensee. 
 
 7. REPRESENTATIONS OF THE SUB-LICENSEE 
 
 The Sub-Licensee hereby represents that: 
 
 he has full legal capacity and power to enter into, exercise its rights and perform its obligations under this Agreement and carry on the business envisaged hereunder; 
 
 he will not utilize the Sub-Licence granted pursuant to this Agreement for any other purpose other than as contemplated hereunder. 
 
 
 8. TERMINATION 
 
 The Sublicense granted here in shall stand invalid and terminated in the event the License granted in favour of the Licensee is terminated by the Licensor at its discretion or in the event of default by the Licensee. 
 
 The Licensee, at its discretion or in the event of default on payment of Sublicense Fee or Service Charges shall have the authority to terminate this Agreement through a revocation notice. 
 
 Either Party may terminate this Agreement without any reason by giving 1 (one) months’ notice to the other Party. 
 
 Upon termination of this Agreement : 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall quit and surrender the Unit in good condition subject to normal wear and tear; 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall peacefully handover the vacant possession of the Unit to the Licensee or the Licensor, as the case maybe, within 30 (thirty) days ; and 
 
 The Licensee shall return the amount of Security Deposit or forfeit the same in the event of default on payment of Sublicense Fee, Service Charges , utilities or any damage caused to the Unit by the Sub Licensee.

 MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS 
 
 
 10.1 SEVERABILITY 
 
 10.1.1 If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or otherwise unenforceable, the enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not be impaired thereby. In such case, the Parties shall make every effort to replace the ineffective provision with a new provision which has the same effect, or as approximate an effect as possible as the said provision. 
 
 
 AMENDMENT 
 
 The Agreement may only be amended / modified in writing and signed by both Parties subject to approval from the Licensor . 
 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The terms and conditions of this Agreement , the Agreement to Sell along with its annexures constitute the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede any prior understandings, agreements or representations by or between the Parties, written or oral. There are no understandings, representations or warranties of any kind whatsoever which shall form an integral part hereof. 
 
 
 ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Sub-Licensee may not assign its rights, obligations or liabilities to any party without the prior written consent of the Licensee. 
 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION 
 
 10.6.1 This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the competent courts at Lahore shall have the exclusive jurisdiction to settle matters arising in respect of this Agreement. 
 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 This Agreement may be executed in 2 (two) counterparts and a copy to be held by each Party. This has the same effect as if the signatures or the counterparts were on a single copy of this Agreement.
